title: After 100 Years of Quantum Mechanics: Toward a Constructive Observation-Centered Perspective
summary: Quantum mechanics owes much of its extraordinary success to a Hilbertian program of mathematical formalization. Yet, the formalism remains poorly aligned with the practical limitations of computations in finite dimensions and under finite accuracy. In this perspective, we argue that this mismatch points to the need for a new mathematical program: a rigorous constructive theory for effective descriptions to identify essential degrees of freedom.
